name: Wake-Rider Crossing
introDiscord:
The last roots of Whispering Kelp Forest disappear behind you.

Ahead, enormous white arches rise through violent crosscurrents.

At first they resemble stone pillars.

Then you notice the joints.

They're ribs.

Something that once lived here was large enough for its skeleton to
reshape the sea.
introTwitch:
The last roots of Whispering Kelp Forest disappear behind you.

Ahead, enormous white arches rise through violent crosscurrents.

At first they resemble stone pillars.

Then you notice the joints.

They're ribs.

Something that once lived here was large enough for its skeleton to
reshape the sea.

wake-rider-crossing-approach.prompt:
Wake-Rider Crossing threads between the first colossal ribs of the
graveyard. Three currents race through the bones while Wake-Riding
Razorfish surf along their edges like they invented bad decisions.

left.message:
A Wake-Riding Razorfish catches the strongest current and rockets around
a rib.

It circles back.

Again.

Apparently you've entered its racetrack.

right.message:
A century-old wreck has been pinned between two ribs.

Its broken strongbox has survived remarkably well considering its current
location inside the skeleton of something larger than the entire ship.

forward.message:
Behind one enormous rib, the violent current disappears completely.

Shizuki once camped in the calm pocket and left a restorative bottle
beneath a note:

'FIRST LEVIATHAN RIB!!!

...I think.

If this is actually a finger I am leaving.'
forward.fullHpMessage:
The restorative remains beneath Shizuki's old campsite.

You're already healthy enough to continue determining which horrifying
anatomical structure you're standing beside.

wake-rider-crossing-depths.prompt:
More bones emerge through the current ahead. Wreckage has collected
between them over centuries, and three routes weave through the
ribcage.

left.message:
An enormous scale has trapped a small cache beneath one edge.

It takes several attempts to accept that the curved object overhead is
one scale.

Shizuki scratched into the nearby stone:

'THAT was on its SKIN?!'

right.message:
A Razorfish shoots through two ribs, uses a wrecked mast as a turning
marker, and races directly back toward you.

Local motorsport remains unregulated.

forward.message:
One Berry rests inside Shizuki's old trail pouch beside a sketch titled:

'EXTREMELY SCIENTIFIC SIZE COMPARISON.'

It shows:

Shizuki: tiny stick figure.

Rib: enormous arch.

Glimmer: tiny glowing blob.

Caption:

'Glimmer says this drawing lacks scale.

THE RIB IS THE SCALE.'

wake-rider-crossing-threshold.prompt:
Near Whitewater Saddle, three routes cross through an immense ribcage
while the current crashes around the bones like permanent surf.

left.message:
Mineral-rich water rises through a crack beneath one rib.

Shizuki left a bottle nearby:

'Good healing spot.

Also excellent place to sit and question how large the REST of it was.'
left.fullHpMessage:
You leave the restorative untouched.

The existential size question remains available.

right.message:
A navigator's chest rests in a calm hollow beneath an enormous vertebra.

The original navigator apparently chose a very unfortunate parking spot.

forward.message:
A Wake-Riding Razorfish launches through the ribs.

For one beautiful second it is airborne in the current.

Then it remembers you exist.

boss-antechamber.name: Whitewater Saddle
boss-antechamber.prompt:
The crosscurrents converge between two towering ribs.

Every ordinary Razorfish suddenly abandons the strongest wake.

bossPromptDiscord:
Whitewater Saddle becomes a roaring tunnel between the bones.

Something much larger catches the current.

A fin cuts through the foam.

Then another.

Whatever rules this crossing has apparently noticed someone using its
racetrack.

Use /yes to enter Whitewater Saddle or /no to retire from competitive
Leviathan-rib racing while you still have the option.
bossPromptTwitch:

Then another.

Whatever rules this crossing has apparently noticed someone using its
racetrack.

Use !yes to enter Whitewater Saddle or !no to retire from competitive

bossRetreatText:
You withdraw between the ribs.

The ordinary Razorfish immediately reclaim the current.

Race resumed.

boss.revealText:
The whitewater explodes as an enormous Razorfish tears across the
Saddle.

Breaker-Fin Alpha reveals itself!

completionText:
Breaker-Fin Alpha disappears down the racing current.

Beyond Whitewater Saddle, the graveyard opens wider.

The first skeleton was enormous.

It is not the only one.
